source.name: Z-Anatomy (Human male model), based on BodyParts3D
attribution: Z-Anatomy - The libre 3D atlas of anatomy - CC-BY-SA 4.0 (https://www.z-anatomy.com/)
BodyParts3D - The Database Center for Life Science - CC-BY-SA 2.1 Japan
Authors: Kousaku Okubo (BodyParts3D), Gauthier Kervyn (design, 3D, anatomy), Marcin Zielinski (Blender add-on), Lluis Vinent (Unity development)
Adapted by the AHI project: structures grouped, decimated, re-oriented and compressed for real time rendering. The derived files are distributed under CC BY-SA 4.0.
excluded: Ear structures (internal ear, auditory ossicles, tympanic membrane, auditory tube, cochlear and vestibular nerves): the upstream model "Anatomy of the Inner Ear" by University of Dundee School of Medicine is CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 (non commercial). Objects: Auditory tube.l, Auditory tube.r, Cochlea.l, Cochlea.r, Cochlear nerve, Cochlear nerve.l, Incus.l, Incus.r, Malleus.l, Malleus.r, Stapes.l, Stapes.r, Tympanic membrane.l, Tympanic membrane.r, Vestibular nerve.l, Vestibular nerve.r, Vestibule.l, Vestibule.r

Kidney, renal pelvis and intrarenal vessel objects: the upstream model "Kidney" by Lissie Cowley is CC BY-NC 4.0 (non commercial). Replaced by AHI procedural kidneys (origin "ahi-procedural") fitted to the atlas bounding boxes. Objects: Intrarenal arteries of left kidney, Intrarenal arteries of right kidney, Intrarenal veins of left kidney, Intrarenal veins of right kidney, Kidney.l, Kidney.r, Renal pelvis.l, Renal pelvis.r

Reproductive structures: not related to any monitored metric; neutral reference body. The atlas stands for every crew member, so the internal and external genital organs, the vessels, nerves and ducts that only serve them and the urethra are not exported, and the external genital region of the body surface (Urogenital region.l, Urogenital region.r) is replaced by a smooth neutral surface inside the "skin" structure. Objects: Corpus cavernosum of penis, Corpus spongiosum of penis, Deep artery of penis.l, Deep artery of penis.r, Deep dorsal vein of penis, Deep external pudendal artery.l, Deep external pudendal artery.r, Dorsal artery of penis.l, Dorsal artery of penis.r, Ductus deferens.l, Ductus deferens.r, Ejaculatory duct.l, Ejaculatory duct.r, Epididymis.l, Epididymis.r, External pudendal veins.l, External pudendal veins.r, Genital branch of genitofemoral nerve.l, Genital branch of genitofemoral nerve.r, Glans penis, Left testicular artery, Left testicular vein, Prostate, Right testicular artery.r, Right testicular vein, Seminal gland.l, Seminal gland.r, Superficial dorsal veins of penis, Superficial external pudendal artery.l, Superficial external pudendal artery.r, Testis.l, Testis.r, Urethra

Not physical bodies: text labels, label leader lines (.j, .i), group titles (.g), muscle origin and insertion maps (.o*, .e*, collection "2: Muscular insertions"), reference lines and planes, cross section planes, objects that exist only in the "Bonus collection".

Left out for clarity and draw call budget: lymph nodes, tonsils, fasciae, bursae, tendon sheaths, ligaments, joint capsules and membranes, meninges, pleura, peritoneum and omenta, ventricles and other cavities, hair, liver segments, small brainstem nuclei, inner white matter surface of the cerebrum.
